obligations.note: The new route POST /payees/{id}/reopen maps to manage_payees, which is in the privileged set, but is declared mfa=False. The exhaustive control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails on exactly this route.
The new Store.reopen_payee only sets status and closed_at and never touches NPI columns. The exhaustive control test test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest passed on the head commit.
The new execute call uses a fixed string literal with payee_id bound as a parameter. The exhaustive control test test_sql_statements_are_parameterized passed on the head commit.
The new state-changing LedgerService.reopen_payee calls _audit with actor, action 'reopen_payee', target and clock time, matching the other operations. The sampled audit control test passed.
Ticket CHG-25756 was approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-04, before review. Its components (payments.http, routes, service, store) cover all four touched files.
Sofia Santos, a payments change_approver who is not the author, approved code_review on the head commit.
The change has a single commit, and both approvals name it (head f280478c).
The CI run on the head commit has result 'failure': 172 tests with 1 failure. The failing test is the registered MFA-1 control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa.
The change touches security-sensitive components (routes, http, store). Security reviewer Ines Halvorsen approved security_review on the head commit.
The change relies on EXC-0210 for the MFA-1 deviation. That exception expired on 2026-09-03, before the review time of 2026-10-12, so it does not count.
Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1) covers routes.py, which this change alters in behaviour, so that evidence has lapsed. The replacement exhaustive control test fails.

summary: The change adds a privileged route (manage_payees) without MFA. This violates MFA-1, and the MFA control test fails in the change's own CI run. The exception the change cites, EXC-0210, expired on 2026-09-03 and cannot cover the deviation. Because CI failed on the final commit, CHG-4 is also unmet, and the earlier MFA-1 evidence has lapsed with no valid replacement. The change is rejected.
